text:
mia.marketing: Quick sync — running a 1-week playtest to improve the pricing calculator & FAQ clarity. Goals: reduce dropoff on calculator, remove ambiguous tier names, and route inbound leads to the right sales stream (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Draft plan below — pls react with :eyes: if you can join.

sam.product: Love it. Can we prioritize flows that trigger 'Dedicated interest' vs 'hosted only'? Need an event schema to make routing reliable.

arjun.analytics: I'll set up funnel + conversion goals. Suggest tracking `started_calculator` -> `selected_tier` -> `contact_form_submit` with prop `tier_choice`. Will create segments and share names.

taylor.sales: If we can auto-tag leads with `commitment_level` and `inbound_channel`, reps can triage faster. Also want an explicit 'book a demo' CTA for Dedicated/Private leads.

emily.growth: A/B idea: test tier naming approach. Variant A (function): "Starter / Scale / Enterprise". Variant B (value-led): "Developer / Business / Dedicated Capacity". See which maps better to conversion.

jordan.docs: I'll draft FAQ updates covering 'billing model (metered vs reserved)', 'dedicated vs hosted', and 'trial credits'. Need final phrasing for SLA and data residency lines.

nina.support: FAQ should explicitly answer "what happens to my data?" and show support SLAs. Also add link to private deploy checklist.

legalbot: Quick flag: avoid explicit SLA numbers in marketing. Use "SLA-backed options available" and Legal will review the exact wording.

mia.marketing: Plan details: user sessions (5 existing customers + 10 prospects) Mon–Wed next week, 20 mins each, moderated. Prototype: https://www.figma.com/proto/pricing-calc-v3 (please don't edit the file). Also running a 2-week website experiment to test CTA routing + messaging.

sam.product: Proposed routing rules (initial) —
```
if deployment_pref == 'private' or region == 'on-prem' -> route -> Enterprise AE
if tokens_per_month_est >= 5_000_000 -> route -> Dedicated queue
else -> route -> Hosted SDR queue
```
I'll formalize these and add to the lead webhook.

arjun.analytics: I'll instrument event `pricing_calc_selection` with props: `tier_name`, `tokens_estimate`, `deployment_preference`, `experiment_id`. ETA: EOD today.

taylor.sales: Can we add a dropdown called "Need compliance review?" so leads who answer yes get bumped to priority queue for Private discussions.

jordan.docs: On confusion points — Mia, from previous tests customers said "Dedicated sounds like a product plan not capacity" and the cost savings modal wasn't obvious. Share the verbatim snippets and I'll iterate.

mia.marketing: From last round: people thought "Dedicated" = different model, not capacity option; calculator defaulted to per-token and didn't show reserved-capacity savings. We should show "estimated monthly cost" AND a quick toggler for "reserved" to show savings.

emily.growth: I'll run two experiment arms: (1) emphasize monthly cost + savings with reserved capacity, (2) emphasize performance benefits (lower latency, guaranteed throughput). We'll track Demo clicks + Contact submits.

nina.support: :thumbsup: Also suggest a small sticky banner on the calc: "Need enterprise help? Book a demo" that opens the same form but pre-fills `lead_source=pricing_calc`.

legalbot: Also include small legal copy near numbers: "Estimates only; final pricing subject to contract." I'll drop suggested copy in the doc.

sam.product: Action list recap: Arjun (events + funnels), Jordan (FAQ copy), Emily (experiment setup), Taylor (sales hooks + dropdown), Nina (banner & support messaging), Mia (user recruitment), Legal (final copy). Can we do a go/no-go by Friday?

mia.marketing: Yes. Please drop availability for user sessions here and tag any blockers. I'll book slots and send calendar invites. :rocket:

arjun.analytics: Available Mon 10–12 PT, Wed 15–17 PT.

taylor.sales: Tue afternoon works for me.

emily.growth: I'll join Mon + Tue morning.

jordan.docs: Wed morning ok.

nina.support: I'll hop in Tue.

legalbot: I'll review copy by Thursday EOD and post comments inline.

sam.product: One more technical ask: add hidden field `experiment_id=pricing_clarity_q2` to the lead form so we can tie conversions back to this test.

mia.marketing: Done. Thanks everyone — I'll post the final plan and a one-page checklist here tomorrow. Please add any follow-ups. :sparkles:
